Our VP of Engineering wants to expand our internal leadership prompt library with three new entries that came up in last quarter's leadership retrospectives. The details of what's needed are in the `new-prompt-requirements.md` file in the workspace.

Please add all three new prompts to the library so that engineering managers can query them using our existing tooling — by category, by keyword search, and by direct ID lookup. The library should end up with 29 prompts total.
